# SPDX-License-Identifier: LGPL-3.0-or-later
"""Backend-agnostic edge-graph neighbor-list contract.

This is the graph-contract portion of the source-pinned DeePMD-kit baseline.
The later geometry builders, reductions, and derivative assembly are not yet
present in this snapshot.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from deepmd.dpmodel.array_api import Array


@dataclass
class NeighborGraph:
    """Edge-graph neighbor list. Node axis is flat ``N = sum(n_node)``."""

    n_node: "Array"
    """(nf,) int nodes per frame."""

    edge_index: "Array"
    """(2, E) int [src, dst]; src=neighbor, dst=center."""

    edge_vec: "Array"
    """(E, 3) float r_src-r_dst; the geometry/autograd leaf."""

    edge_mask: "Array"
    """(E,) bool real edge versus padding edge."""

    n_local: "Array | None" = None
    angle_index: "Array | None" = None
    angle_mask: "Array | None" = None


@dataclass
class GraphLayout:
    """Length policy: dynamic axes use ``None``; static backends use capacity."""

    edge_capacity: int | None = None
    angle_capacity: int | None = None
    node_capacity: int | None

"""Edge-graph geometry and differential-observable utilities.

The graph uses one flat, frame-major node axis.  An edge is directed from a
neighbor (``src``) to its center atom (``dst``), and its differentiable
